# opnsense_nginx_errorpage (Data Source)

Custom nginx error pages (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Error Pages**, plugin `os-nginx`), used by HTTP servers and locations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx error page.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Enter a name for your error page.
- `pagecontent` (String) The HTML page content to display.
- `redirect` (String) Instead of displaying a static error page redirect to a URL.
- `response` (String) Optionally enter a HTTP status code to change the response to. This does not work in combination with a redirection target. One of `200`, `300`, `301`, `302`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `451`, `500`, `503`.
- `statuscodes` (Set of String) Enter the HTTP status codes for which the error page shall be shown. One of `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `405`, `407`, `408`, `410`, `415`, `429`, `431`, `500`, `501`, `502`, `503`, `504`.
